meta.title: Sign in
meta.description: Sign in to EdFind to keep your matches across devices.

login.heading: Sign in to EdFind
login.description: Your matches, shortlist, and tracked applications stay with you across devices. We only use your Google account for authentication — never to post or email anything.
login.consent: By continuing you agree to share your Google profile (name and email) with EdFind for account purposes.

errors.missingCode: Sign-in didn't complete — please try again.
errors.exchangeFailed: Couldn't complete sign-in. Please try again.

verified.title: University email verified!
verified.description: {email} is linked to your EdFind account. You can now write in the community — chat in groups, post reviews, and ask questions.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.description: Confirmation links are valid for 24 hours. Request a new one from the community page and check your inbox again.

invalid.title: Invalid confirmation link
invalid.conflictTitle: This email was just verified elsewhere
invalid.description: The link is incomplete or was replaced by a newer request. Open the most recent email, or request a new link from the community page.
invalid.conflictDescription: A university email can only be linked to one account. If that wasn't you, request a new link from the community page.
